notes: Distances are straight-line (haversine, R=6371008.8 m) between the listed coordinates, rounded to metres. Real walking routes, open gates and accessibility are NOT verified.
est_walk_min is a rough estimate = straight_line_m x 1.3 detour factor / 70 m per minute, rounded up. It is a model-free heuristic, not a measured route; label it 'estimate' in UI.
dwell_min values are editorial estimates (research), not from any source.
Palace-interior stops (Geunjeongjeon, Gyeonghoeru) require palace entry; hours, closures (Tuesday) and fees must be checked on the visit day (visitseoul:gyeongbokgung-operation).
Coordinates: gwanghwamun/tosokchon = data/catalog.json; geunjeongjeon/gyeonghoeru/bukchon = Wikipedia infobox (see landmarks.json evidence).

routes.summary_en: Front gate, throne hall, banquet pavilion, then a samgyetang lunch nearby.
routes.summary_ko: 정문, 중심 건물, 연회장을 보고 근처에서 삼계탕 점심.

stops.note: Lunch. Opening, stock and dietary suitability unverified.

legs.note: Requires leaving the palace; the west gate Yeongchumun (opened Dec 2018, links to Seochon per visitseoul:gyeongbokgung-culture) is a candidate exit but its current opening and the street path are unverified.

routes.summary_en: Royal gate and throne hall, then the lanes of Bukchon's traditional houses.
routes.summary_ko: 궁궐 정문과 중심 건물을 보고 북촌 한옥 골목으로.

time_window_note.text_en: Plan Bukchon between 10 a.m. and 5 p.m. (Bukchon-ro 11-gil; VisitKorea and 2024 Seoul notice; re-check).
